name: Taise

attributes.attribute: a wife of the hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill
married to free her father Abarta from the Fianna

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Taise is a minor Irish heroine of the old tales. She married the hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill. She did this to free her father. Her father Abarta had been captured and placed in the care of the Fianna.

okr.objective: Describe Taise, a minor Irish heroine.
key_results: Taise became a wife of the hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill.
She married to free her father Abarta from the Fianna.
